stem: The central idea of Roland's paper is weak. Which of the following could replace sentence 3 and provide a better central idea for this paper?

options.label: A
options.text: For my paper I would like to tell you that you should definitely and for sure get a hedgehog this time.

options.label: B
options.text: Everyone likes to try different things, so this time don’t do the same thing again and get a hedgehog.

options.label: C
options.text: Instead of choosing a traditional pet, such as a dog, a cat, or a guinea pig, you might want to get a hedgehog.

options.label: D
options.text: Because you would like to try something that isn’t very normal, get a hedgehog.
